scripts.build: npm run build --prefix ../client && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('public',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync('../client/dist','public',{recursive:true});" && tsc
scripts.test:coverage: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.coverage-build', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.coverage.json && c8 node --test .coverage-build/*.test.js .coverage-build/db/*.test.js
